messages.content: Find the area and perimeter of a circle with a radius of 5 and also find the circumference of a circle with diameter of 10.

function.name: circle_calculate_circumference
function.description: Calculate the circumference of a circle based on the diameter. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: circle_calculate_area
function.description: Calculate the area of a circle based on the radius. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

function.name: rectangle_calculate_perimeter
function.description: Calculate the perimeter of a rectangle based on the length and breadth. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

Circumference radius 5: 2πr = 10π ≈ 31.4159.

Circumference diameter 10: πd = 10π ≈ 31.4159. So same as above.
